note: Mutants of the hiding of the fullscreen replay bar (docs/REPLAYS.md "Hiding the bar") for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): the state machine in web/replay_page.js against tests/scripts/web_replay_bar_check.js (node, a fake clock) and the glue, the style and the docs against tests/scripts/test_web_replay_bar.py. Run from the checkout: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/replay_bar_hide_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 300. Every mutant must be caught; the same test file runs the list in the quick tier on a copy. Each `why` names what the mutant loses.

mutants.why: a mouse passing the bottom edge would open the bar at once
a peeking bar would go while the pointer is still on its way back
the bottom band would be too thin to find
a drag along the bottom edge would open the bar
a drag of the timeline that leaves the bar would hide it under the pointer
the open Picture window would be hidden with the bar
a peeking bar would go while the pointer is on it
a peek would outlive fullscreen
a hide during the 150 ms would still open
a peek that a button held would stay until the next move
a peek would stay when the mouse leaves the page
the black bars beside a narrow picture would open the bar
the handle would not pin the bar
a locked cursor could press buttons of a bar that is not there
a mouse move, a key or a click would bring a hidden bar back
the idle fade would race the leave time
the chevron would not hide the bar
there would be no key
the game would get the B key too
the handle would be too small to hit
a finger would have to hit 14 px

mutants.old: opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);
mutants.new: opacity: 0; visibility: visible; pointer-events: none; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(14px);
mutants.why: a hidden bar would keep its focus stops
the bar would slide for a viewer who asked for none
a finger moving along the bottom would open the bar

mutants.old: if (ANTS_REPLAY_MODE && window.antsReplayZone) window.antsReplayZone(rect.left + lockCursor.x, rect.top + lockCursor.y, e.buttons);
mutants.why: a locked mouse could not call the bar at all
a finger would get a strip and a handle both
a peek would come back with the next fullscreen
a keyboard viewer would lose the focus when the bar comes up

mutants.old: id="b-handle" aria-label="Show the bar" aria-controls="rbar" aria-expanded="false"
mutants.why: a screen reader would not hear the state

mutants.old: or the **B** key: the bar is not there at all
mutants.new: or a key: the bar is not there at all
mutants.why: the docs would not name the key
a pointer resting in the game's edge scroll strip would bring the bar up over the picture while the map scrolls
the least gap would shrink: a picture at its own size would call the bar from the game's scroll strip
on a 1440p or 4K screen the game's scroll strip is wider than 12 px and a pointer resting in it would bring the bar up

a hand that trembles by a pixel would never open the bar

mutants.new: function reach(cx, cy) { return under(cx, cy); }

a locked cursor would press a handle that is not shown
